source: can you create a game where it gives a creepy vibe and you suddenly wake up at 1am to your friend jasmine calling you and telling you to play the game 'flowers' so you agree and start bootting up the game after you end the call and you press start. A person named angel with a pastel flower crown,white oversized hoodie,short pink shirt,arm warmers and light purple socks on greets you in a flower field with a blue sky,fluffy clouds and soft music. its a pick your awnser game with 5 endings, good,bad,virus,stuck forever, and pulled into screen. you also do litte tasks like feed the kois in her beautiful koi pond and so on.

answers.ask: How much of the bedroom is built - the whole room, or just the bit you see from the bed?
answers.answer: Just the portion visible from the bed; keep the opening bedroom scene small and focused on waking up and Jasmine's call.

answers.ask: Do the five endings each need their own place, or do they all play out in the flower field?
answers.answer: Have all five endings play out in the flower field, with the ending presentation changing there rather than building separate areas.

- [scale] How much of the bedroom is built - the whole room, or just the bit you see from the bed? Just the portion visible from the bed; keep the opening bedroom scene small and focused on waking up and Jasmine's call.
- [goal] Do the five endings each need their own place, or do they all play out in the flower field? Have all five endings play out in the flower field, with the ending presentation changing there rather than building separate areas.
config.genre_evidence: It is a narrative, choice-driven experience: "pick your awnser game with 5 endings" and small contextual tasks such as "feed the kois." The built play space is primarily the flower field where all endings occur, supporting story progression and exploration rather than combat, racing, or a full simulation.
config.evidence: "Have all five endings play out in the flower field" and the tasks include feeding koi in "her beautiful koi pond."
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Adventure map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Bounded Play Space: One clearly bounded, single-level space that the whole activity happens inside.

INCLUDE:
- Ambient Population: The non-hostile characters who inhabit the space — shopkeepers, wandering crowds, ambient animals, a named figure players come to see — and the ground they occupy.
- Water Body: Standing or flowing water as a real feature of the map — a lake, river, sea, or pool — whether swum through or treated as a barrier.
